description: This file defines the 'Patient' class, an extension of the 'Person' class within the OpenMRS system. It manages patient-specific data such as identifiers, allergy status, and related methods for handling identifiers and patient attributes.

classes.name: Patient
classes.description: Represents a patient as an extension of the Person class, including methods for managing identifiers and patient-specific information.

methods.name: getPatientId
methods.description: Returns the internal identifier for the patient, defaulting to the person's ID if not explicitly set.

methods.name: setPatientId
methods.description: Sets the internal identifier for the patient, supporting infrastructure usage.

methods.name: getAllergyStatus
methods.description: Returns the current allergy status of the patient.

methods.name: setAllergyStatus
methods.description: Sets the allergy status for the patient.

methods.name: addIdentifier
methods.description: Adds a new PatientIdentifier to the patient's set of identifiers if it does not already exist.

methods.name: getIdentifiers
methods.description: Retrieves all identifiers (voided and active) for the patient.

methods.name: getActiveIdentifiers
methods.description: Returns a list of all non-voided patient identifiers, prioritizing preferred ones.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifier
methods.description: Gets the preferred identifier for the patient, prioritizing non-voided and preferred identifiers.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the patient's identifier of a specific type.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the patient's identifier matching a specific type ID.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the patient's identifier matching a given type name.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the patient object.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the patient's ID, as per OpenMRSObject interface.

methods.name: getPerson
methods.description: Returns the Person object represented by this Patient.
